memory_bridge: Let the sun brighten the eastern tree twice: first as the skyline of 東京 for On トウ, then as the compass direction 東 for Kun ひがし.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 東京（とうきょう）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Grow the eastern tree into the skyline of 東京（とうきょう）; the city name begins with On トウ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 東（ひがし）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Turn from the skyline to the sunrise itself and point 東（ひがし）; the standalone native direction word fixes Kun ひがし, “east.”

memory_bridge: The elephant acts on a tiny stage: a spotlight points down to the cause in 因为, wèi; then the elephant rises into a new role in 成为, wéi.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 因为 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: A spotlight points down at why the elephant acted: 因为—because. Wèi drops with the beam onto the cause.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 成为 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The elephant rises onto a platform and 成为—becomes—the star; wéi climbs with the transformation.
